title: PMP Limited and McPherson's Limited book printing businesses - proposed joint venture

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed date of 13 June 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings, amended to allow for consideration of further information.

ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns. Former proposed date of 20 June 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings amended to allow for consultation on Statement of Issues.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Former proposed date of 18 July 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings, amended to allow for consideration of further information.
Former proposed date of 1 August 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings, amended to allow for consideration of further information.
ACCC announced it would oppose the proposed transaction.

body_sections.Competition analysis: Please see Public Competition Assessment attached below.
